story.title: Crusoe abandons $1.25B plan to use Boom turbines at AI data centers
story.summary: Boom Supersonic CEO Blake Scholl said the company's new stationary power plants were no longer in Crusoe's near-term plans.
story.viral_reason: AI’s green‑energy promise collapses as Crusoe aborts a $1.25 B turbine plan, exposing a sustainability lie.
story.angle: The massive turbine project was never a genuine climate solution—it was a PR stunt to placate investors, and its cancellation reveals how AI’s carbon‑hungry expansion is being hidden behind green‑washed narratives.
